documentCard.title: Student Terms & Conditions
documentCard.description: Enable Terms & Conditions to require learners to digitally sign the agreement before they can access their dashboard content.
documentCard.pdfDescription: Upload the base PDF document. When a learner accepts it, their name and date will be appended as a new page.
documentCard.nameDescription: Choose how the learner's name is captured when they sign the Terms & Conditions.
documentCard.prefillHintOn: The learner's registered name will be auto-filled and locked on the signature field.
documentCard.prefillHintOff: The learner will be required to type their full name manually when signing.

notifyCard.title: Notify on Sign
notifyCard.description: Send an email notification with the signed PDF link whenever a student accepts the Terms & Conditions.
notifyCard.recipientEmailsHint: Separate multiple email addresses with commas. Each address will receive the signed PDF link.

toasts.missingFile: Please upload a PDF file to enable Terms & Conditions
toasts.missingEmails: Please enter at least one recipient email for notifications
